decision.summary: Only one plausible temporary offset interval is identified: a U-dominated depression from index 600 to 629, with delayed N response and ambiguous recovery. The rebound starting at ~630 is observed but not completed within allowed context (ends at 670), and no opposing return is confirmed on N or E. All candidate intervals remain uncertain due to incomplete return evidence or superposed motion.

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp drop (~−15 MAD) at indices 600–602, sustained through ~629; N exhibits a delayed step up (~+3 MAD) around 605–610; E shows non-monotonic behavior without clear opposing return. Return in U begins at ~630 but is not fully completed within allowed context (ends at 670), and no clear opposing edge observed on N/E before 670. Hence status uncertain.

A smaller, earlier offset candidate near index 593 (N↑, U↓) lacks clear sustained interior or return; U does not show distinct depression before 600, and N/E do not confirm a coherent temporary interval. No confirmed onset–return pair. Excluded due to insufficient evidence.

At index 625, U rebounds sharply (+7 MAD), N/E rise (+12, +6 MAD); however, this coincides with the tail of the prior U depression and no clear opposing return to the earlier drop is observed—U remains elevated after 625, suggesting possible permanent offset or incomplete recovery. Return not confirmed; status uncertain.
